entries: Population limit updated with the 18 MeerKAT binaries

Owner instruction 'Yes update it'. 289 pulsars (271 isolated + 18 binaries, all NO_TRIGGER). 0.1 Earth mass at 60-240 d: about 8.7% to 6.2-6.6%; 10 Earth masses at 30-240 d: 1.1-1.2%. Isolated-only tables reproduce exactly.
No observations read, no search run. Binary masses assume 1.6 solar-mass inner system. Two populations combined; NANOGrav binaries and 14 held MeerKAT binaries not included.
